fields.label: Mentor Services Item
fields.description: Item used for all Purchase Invoice line entries. Typically 'Mentor Services'.

fields.label: Mentor Expense Account
fields.description: Expense account for recording mentor gross payouts. Typically 'Mentor Expense'.

fields.label: Mentor Commission Account
fields.description: Income account for recording platform commission deductions. Typically 'Mentor Commission'.

fields.label: Penalty Payable Account
fields.description: Liability account for holding student refunds and absenteeism penalties. Typically 'Penalty Payable'.

fields.label: TDS Payable Account
fields.description: Tax/Liability account for recording TDS deductions. Typically 'TDS Payable'.

fields.label: Razorpay Clearing Account
fields.description: Clearing asset account for student gateway payments. Typically 'Razorpay Clearing'.

fields.label: Sales Account
fields.description: Income account for booking session purchase revenues. Typically 'Sales'.
